supersedes_none: v1 and v2 gate backtests remain their own frozen audit records; this is a distinct hypothesis.
objective: Measure whether the LIVE v3 ETF desk (eruption-only veto, all three structures routed by point-in-time Qlib lean, defined-risk, $1000 cap) is profitable over 2019-2026 when winners are closed at a 50%-of-credit profit target, and whether it clears the canonical overfit gate.
hypothesis: Routing by Qlib lean and closing at 50% of max profit produces a positive, regime-stable equity curve and at least a decidable (not necessarily passing) gate result on cluster-adjusted observations.

scope.mode: offline research; SHADOW advisory only; no broker integration; informs but does not change the live desk
scope.routing: combined point-in-time Qlib lean: +1 -> put spread, -1 -> call spread, 0 -> iron condor
scope.price_source: local qlib_lab/csv/<asset>.csv, Yahoo back-adjustment undone via the factor column

entry_policy.hard_veto: predicted vol eruption OR missing/stale signal ONLY (matches live v3). Magnitude and calm do NOT filter.

qlib_filter.iron_condor_conviction: neutral lean carries no conviction bar; it instead requires the richer iron-condor IV/RV floor

entry_policy.contracts: monthly third-Friday nearest 45 DTE within 30-60; short leg ~0.30 delta; long leg exactly spread_width beyond
entry_policy.pop_definition: Probability of profit AT EXPIRY (tastytrade convention): the risk-neutral BS probability that the underlying finishes on the profitable side of the structure's breakeven(s). Put spread: P(S_T > short_strike - credit). Call spread: P(S_T < short_strike + credit). Iron condor: P(lower_BE < S_T < upper_BE). Uses entry IV and DTE. NOTE: closing at the 50% target realizes profit MORE often than this at-expiry POP, so 0.51 is a conservative floor.
entry_policy.non_overlap: one open position per (symbol, structure); no new entry until the prior one exits

exit_policy.rule: 50% profit target: close the first day the position's marked profit reaches 50% of entry credit.
exit_policy.fallback: if the target is never reached, settle at expiration intrinsic value (hold-to-expiry).
exit_policy.costs: BACKTEST_COST_PER_LEG_RT applied per leg, round trip
exit_policy.also_reported: a hold-to-expiry variant on the SAME entries is reported side-by-side so the target's effect is legible (not a separate promotion claim).

declared_deviations.deviation: no historical option quotes exist on this box
declared_deviations.consequence: the 50%-target crossing is detected by BS-REPRICING each leg along the daily underlying path

declared_deviations.deviation: entry implied volatility is held CONSTANT along the repricing path
declared_deviations.reason: no historical IV surface; entry IV itself is proxied (RV20 x market premium factor, as in v1/v2)
declared_deviations.consequence: ignores vol expansion/contraction after entry. For a short-premium book this is OPTIMISTIC (a real vol spike would raise the cost to close and delay/deny the target). Measured edge is an UPPER BOUND; never presented as executable.

declared_deviations.deviation: entry credit is a model credit, not natural bid/ask
declared_deviations.consequence: entry pricing is optimistic vs live execution, same as v1/v2

independence_and_inference.required_handling: cluster same-date entries into one observation (mean PnL), as in v1/v2
independence_and_inference.profitability_reporting: per-year table (n, win rate, PnL, PF, avg holding days, % exited at target) + a cumulative equity curve. Descriptive; the gate verdict is the promotion test, not the equity curve.

trial_accounting.reason: 31 symbols x 3 structures = 93 symbol-structure hypotheses reachable under this rule.
trial_accounting.no_threshold_softening: Canonical thresholds fixed: PBO < 0.5 AND Deflated Sharpe > 0. A positive equity curve or high PF never overrides a failed DSR.
trial_accounting.no_p_hacking: This experiment is registered ONCE. If the result is poor we do NOT retune v3 on the same data to make it pass. Any parameter change (delta, DTE, target %, universe, exit) is a NEW pre-registered variant (v4) and re-counts trials. Adopting the 50% target in the LIVE desk is a separate change with its own pre-registration.

falsifiable_predictions: 50%-target cluster-adjusted total PnL differs from the hold-to-expiry variant (target changes the distribution)
promotion: No promotion. A pass changes only a display badge. Live adoption additionally requires natural-pricing confirmation, live-quote liquidity validation, an honest vol-path treatment, and human review.
